name: Strictly Business
source:
As Tenya Iida, you suddenly receive a confession letter from a student in the Business Course. However, you have no time for falling in love!

Your goal is to go the rest of the year without falling for his charms.

[From [url=https://raccoonbutler.itch.io/strictly-business]itch.io[/url]]
